title: Apple's 2nm M6 reaches the MacBook Pro with memory-driven storage premiums
summary: Apple's first 2nm chip is now in the entry 14-inch MacBook Pro, which starts at $1,999 with 16GB of memory and 1TB of storage; preorders opened on 28 October and shipping begins on 6 November. The M6 moves to a 12-core CPU, a dual 16-core Neural Engine and, via the N1 chip, Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6. Storage upgrades rose: 4TB now costs $1,500 more, against $1,200 a year ago, which Apple attributes to the memory shortage.
